title: DiagPong
description: Result of `diag.ping`, carrying the `seq` the hub assigned. Like every event it is fanned out to every connection observing the session, not only to the one that asked.

pingedAt.description: ISO 8601 instant in UTC, read from the server clock.

pingCount.description: How many times this session has been pinged, counting this one.

nonce.description: Echo of the nonce the command carried.
